leakage_audit.comparison_policy: All checkpoints are rescored on the identical retained queries, documents and original labels; filtering depends only on leakage checks, not model scores.
limitations: Hashes cannot establish absence of all fuzzy/semantic near duplicates in past training text.
Train reservations include prefetched samples, so exclusions are conservative.
BKAI training overlap is unknown; its score is a reference.
Train history retains content hashes, not a complete text journal; exhaustive fuzzy/semantic near-duplicate checking against all past training text is not possible.
No claim is made about overlap with BKAI's original pretraining/fine-tuning data.
This is a held-out sample of the streaming sources, not an official full-corpus benchmark.
Candidate pool is about four thousand passages, not millions; scores should not be presented as full-corpus production accuracy.
Unjudged relevant passages can be scored as negatives; teacher is not ground truth.
CPU float32 inference; live training uses CUDA bfloat16.
This evaluated subset is now development evidence; keep a separate untouched final test for future model selection.
numerical_verification: All dense vectors finite and unit norm; independent rank counting matches full sorting; historical embeddings reproduce historical metrics before any exclusions.
interpretation: No demonstrated aggregate retrieval gain since step 108000. Latest point estimates are below step 190399; overall paired CI includes zero.
